defect: The generated clock declares divide_by 3 although the output toggles every three source cycles and therefore has a divide-by-6 period.
rationale: The divider toggles its output on each terminal count, so a complete output cycle takes two groups of three source cycles. The declared generated period is twice too fast for the slow_logic receiver.

mutation.description: Used the terminal-count interval as divide_by instead of accounting for both output edges.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: The divider toggles its output once per three input cycles; a full output clock cycle therefore takes six source cycles. The declared divide_by 3 is incorrect.
